claims.title: How does a local filtration put a matrix in the tangent space of the global image?
claims.hypotheses: At a place above ℓ the representation has a finite de Rham model and a specified inducing embedding. Its filtration jumps include m distinct integers with unequal disjoint subset means.
claims.statement: The Hodge–Tate change of basis in the completed algebraic closure gives a multiplicative curve in the zero locus of the global image equations. Its derivative at the identity has the full multiset of jumps as eigenvalues.

claims.statement: The tangent equations, root equations and finitely many unequal-mean conditions have a simultaneous solution over the coefficient field.

claims.title: Why can the tangent matrix have only the prescribed eigenvalues?
claims.hypotheses: A continuous matrix representation over an algebraically closed topological field of characteristic zero has degree-at-most-m annihilators on a dense set. A chosen tangent has m distinct eigenvalues.
claims.statement: Degree at most m is expressed by minors of the matrix-power columns and extends to the full image and every tangent at the identity. The chosen tangent has square-free minimal polynomial of degree m. Its eigenspace projectors sum to the identity, with unrestricted positive multiplicities at this stage.

claims.title: How do the blocks give a representation of dimension m?

claims.statement: Once the full group belongs to the stated algebra, compatible matrix units give an m-dimensional coefficient representation, its individual copies in the original space and injections in the two required directions.

claims.title: What happens when a group element permutes the weight spaces?
claims.hypotheses: A semisimple representation has the uniform degree bound m and a tangent with m lacunary eigenvalues. The subgroup is normal of finite index.
claims.statement: A finite-index subgroup retains the tangent at the identity. After correction by elementary units and a diagonal perturbation in its closure, each permutation cycle supplies its length in distinct eigenvalues and different cycles have disjoint spectra.
